notes.title: Umbra: The Last Summoner now out!
notes.content:
[h2]The wait is over! [/h2]

The realm of Umbra: The Last Summoner is calling, now fully released and polished for your ultimate adventure. After months of fixes, improvements, and community feedback, the game has evolved into the epic journey it was meant to be.

[h2]Master the arcane, summon legendary allies, and shape the fate of Umbra![/h2]

This isn't just a game; it's your story. Every decision you make, every battle you fight, and every alliance you forge will shape a unique tale in a world filled with mystery and magic. Will you rise as the hero Umbra needs or let the shadows take over?

Celebrate the full release with new features and improvements:

Battle Enhancements

Enemy elements are now displayed during team selection for better strategy.
The battle timeline has been refined for clarity.
Comprehensive balancing ensures every encounter feels rewarding.
Expanded Options and Knowledge

A new in-game library explains symbols, status effects, and mechanics in detail.
Helpful tooltips guide you at the start of your journey.
Enhanced sensitivity options for rotation, skippable cutscenes, and manual save functionality.
Bug Fixes and Quality of Life

Addressed game-breaking spell interactions and UI glitches.
Fixed the minimap, ensuring it remains active and intuitive.
Improved text and localization for a seamless narrative experience.


[h2]Begin your legend today![/h2]

Embark on this adventure now on Steam. Whether you're returning or a first-time summoner, the world of Umbra awaits your bravery and cunning. The journey has just begun—are you ready to make history?

notes.title: 🎉 Umbra: The Last Summoner Has Arrived! 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]The wait is over! [/h2]

Prepare to immerse yourself in the rich, detailed world of Umbra: The Last Summoner, now available for all adventurers. This isn't just a game; it's an epic saga waiting to unfold, starring you as the last hope of a world teetering on the brink of chaos.

[h2]Unleash your powers, summon legendary heroes, and battle formidable foes in a land steeped in mystery and magic. [/h2]

Each choice you make influences the fate of Umbra, crafting a story unique to your journey. Are you ready to answer the call and become the hero Umbra needs?

Celebrate with us by diving into this sprawling fantasy universe that challenges your strategic thinking and rewards your bravery. Embark on quests, uncover secrets, and forge alliances to fight against the darkness threatening to consume the land.

[h2]Start your journey now! [/h2]
Grab your copy on Steam and join the legion of summoners in Umbra: The Last Summoner. The realm of Umbra awaits your legend.
